title: BMUnun okutuuchuluk kurama spartakiadada baygeluu orundardy eeledi

blocks.text: 2025-zhyldyn 23-junun 30-junun cheyinki kundoru Ysyk-Kol oblusunun Bosteri ayilynda zhaygashkan “Kyrgyz Denizi” den sooluktu chyndoo sanatoriuminde zhogorku okuu jailarynda emgetenip zhatkan okutuuchu-professorduk kuramdar arasynda өtkөrүlgon “Den sooluk - 2025” spartakiadasyna academician K. Karasaev atyndagy Bishkek mamlekettik universityinen sportstun eki turunon үch kurama team katyshyp, bardyk komandalar iygilik menen kelishti. Alar: 45 zhashka cheyinker arasynda yushturulgan kichi football boyuncha myrzalar arasynda okutuuchularybyz 3-orundu, oshondoy ele 45 zhashtan zhogorkular arasynda yushturulgan kichi football boyuncha myrzalar arasynda okutuuchularybyz 3-orundu, al emi 45 zhashka cheyinki kyz-kelinder arasynda yushturulgan volleyball oyunu boyuncha okutuuchularybyz 3-orundu kamsyzdashty.

Academician K. Karasaev atyndagy Bishkek mamlekettik universityinen “Den Sooluk - 2025” spartakiadasyna katyshyp iigilik zharatkan professorduk-okutuuchuluk kuramga bekem den sooluk, isterine alban-alban iigilikterdi kaalaibyz.
